sum: Three days from Kathmandu: by road to Charikot, on foot or by jeep to the lodge village of Kuri, then up a stone path or a cable car to the Kalinchowk Bhagwati shrine.

guide.note: Kalinchowk lies inside the Gaurishankar Conservation Area, and the Nepal Tourism Board has required foreign trekkers to hire a licensed guide since April 2023. Checks on the trail are inconsistent, and it is not clear that permits or guides are looked at in Kuri at all. A guide earns the fee on the walk from Charikot, where the footpath keeps leaving and rejoining the jeep road without signs, and as the person who will notice altitude sickness and get you down.

access: Charikot is about 130 km from Kathmandu by the Araniko Highway and the Jiri road, five to six hours by bus. From Charikot a steep, unsealed road of about 17 km climbs to Kuri; shared and hired jeeps take one to two hours. Snow can close the upper part for days in winter, and landslides do the same in the monsoon, so ask in Charikot before you set out.

photo.a: The blue and red roofs of the lodges at Kuri stand out against deep snow, below a rocky, snow-covered ridge and a dark blue sky.
photo.c: Kuri, the lodge village below the Kalinchowk shrine, under snow

permits.name: Gaurishankar Conservation Area Permit
permits.where: Online at NTNC's e-permit site or at the Tourist Service Centre in Bhrikutimandap, Kathmandu. A permit issued at a trail checkpost costs double.

tips: Buy the Gaurishankar Conservation Area permit online or in Kathmandu before you leave. A permit issued at a checkpost costs double, and we could not confirm that one can be bought in Kuri.
Go midweek if you can. Kuri's lodges fill on Fridays and Saturdays from December to February.
Bring a sleeping bag or ask for extra quilts. The only warm place in a Kuri lodge is beside the stove in the dining room.
Eat lightly, drink plenty of water and keep alcohol for Charikot. Drinking at this height is a common cause of a bad night.
Cable car tickets are sold only at the Kuri station; the operator listed NPR 1,300 return for foreigners when we checked. Ask on arrival whether it is running.

days.note: East on the Araniko Highway to Khadichaur, then up the Jiri road, over the high ridge beyond Mude and down to Charikot. A night here at 1,970 m, instead of driving straight on to Kuri, gives your body a first step up. Draw cash and buy snacks in the bazaar this evening.

An easy first hour along the road to Deurali, then uphill for the rest of the day through rhododendron forest, cutting across the bends of the jeep road, with a tea stop at the pasture of Gairi and little else. You gain about 1,400 m. Walk slowly, drink often and expect to feel the height by evening.
why: A climb of 1,400 m in one day, to sleep at 3,370 m. Go slowly, drink plenty, and say so if you get a headache.

days.t: Kalinchowk shrine, back to Kuri, drive to Kathmandu
days.note: Set out before dawn for the hour to hour and a half up the stone path and the final steps to the shrine, or take the cable car once it opens. Be back in Kuri for breakfast, then ride a jeep down to Charikot and go on to Kathmandu by bus or car: six to eight hours of road, so leave Kuri by mid-morning.
